general_information.name: I THINK YOU MEAN MY FULL NAME? I USUALLY JUST GO BY SOPHIE. IF YOU NEED THE EXACT LEGAL VERSION, I CAN GIVE THAT TOO.

current_concerns.primary_problems: It’s been these really upsetting intrusive images about something bad happening to my baby. They started after she was born, and I keep checking on her at night.
current_concerns.goals: I want the thoughts to stop, and I’d really like to feel okay caring for my daughter on my own.
